purityGuide.title: How to Test Saffron Purity at Home
purityGuide.subtitle: We are so confident in the absolute purity of AMMu Foods Saffron that we encourage every customer to perform these simple tests the moment their package arrives.

tests.title: 1. The Cold Water Test
tests.summary: Drop 3-4 AMMu saffron threads into a glass of cold water.
tests.pureResult: Pure saffron takes 10 to 15 minutes to release its hue, turning the water into an ethereal golden-yellow / amber shade. The original thread remains intact and crimson red.
tests.fakeResult: Fake or dyed saffron turns the water deep red immediately within seconds, and the threads turn white or lose their color.

tests.title: 2. The Baking Soda Test
tests.summary: Mix a pinch of baking soda into water, then add a thread of saffron.
tests.pureResult: Genuine saffron will maintain a clean, vibrant golden yellow liquid.
tests.fakeResult: Artificially dyed threads react with alkaline baking soda and turn a murky red or brown color.

tests.title: 3. The Finger Rub Test
tests.summary: Soak a thread for 5 minutes, then rub it between two fingers.
tests.pureResult: Real saffron thread stays firm, flexible, and does not disintegrate into a paste.
tests.fakeResult: Imitation saffron (such as dyed corn silk or plastic) turns to mush or breaks apart instantly.

faqs.q: Why is AMMu Saffron priced at ₹347 - ₹378 for 1g?
faqs.a: By sourcing directly from generational saffron harvesters in Kashmir and packaging directly through Infinity Food Consumer (Jhansi), AMMu Foods cuts out 3 to 4 layers of middlemen and brokers, offering true Grade A++ Kashmiri Kesar at honest prices on Meesho, Amazon, and Flipkart.

faqs.q: How many uses or servings are in a 1-gram pack?
faqs.a: One gram of pure saffron contains approximately 400 to 450 stigmas. Because authentic Grade A++ Mongra has extreme coloring and flavor potency, only 3–5 threads are needed per serving. A 1g pack comfortably provides 50 to 80 servings of saffron milk or dozens of family culinary dishes.

faqs.q: What is the best way to extract maximum flavor and color from saffron?
faqs.a: Lightly crush 4-5 threads in a mortar or between your fingertips, then steep in 2 tablespoons of warm (not boiling) milk or water for 15–20 minutes before adding to your dish. The liquid will develop an intense golden amber hue and rich aroma.

faqs.q: How should I store AMMu saffron to keep it fresh?
faqs.a: Always store your saffron in its original airtight AMMu container in a cool, dry, dark pantry away from direct sunlight and humidity. Never store saffron in the refrigerator, as condensation can introduce moisture and weaken the aroma.
